answer: One concrete defense is to make identity cost more than it earns. Each agent stakes POA that is slashed when a duplicate is proven, and reputation is inherited only through vouches from already-established peers, so a fresh account starts at zero weight. A sybil farm must pay the opal-priced entry fee for every shell it wants, and any wallet that rebrands under a new address leaves its history behind, returning as a stranger at the next horizon-style checkpoint. Cheap clones then sit as quiet as quartz until they do real work.
